steps.script: (()=>{const b=document.querySelector('#search a, #searchBtn a, #btnSearch a, span.button.search a');if(!b)throw new Error('조회 버튼 없음');b.click();})()

(()=>{const ids=["exportExcel"];const bad=ids.filter(id=>{const b=document.getElementById(id);const v=!!b&&b.offsetParent!==null&&getComputedStyle(b).display!=='none';return v!==true});if(bad.length)throw new Error('버튼 노출 불일치(기대 표시): '+bad.join(','));})()

(async()=>{const r=await fetch(uxl.getFunctionUrl('VOC1019','INQUIRY'),{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded','X-Requested-With':'XMLHttpRequest'},body:""});const t=await r.text();const st=(t.match(/"resultStatus":"(\w+)"/)||[])[1]||'';const denied=t.includes('권한이 없습니다');if(st!=='Success')throw new Error('VOC1019 INQUIRY 기대 Success, 실제 '+st+(denied?'(권한없음)':''));})()

(async()=>{const r=await fetch(uxl.getFunctionUrl('VOC1019','EXPORT'),{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/x-www-form-urlencoded','X-Requested-With':'XMLHttpRequest'},body:""});const t=await r.text();const st=(t.match(/"resultStatus":"(\w+)"/)||[])[1]||'';const denied=t.includes('권한이 없습니다');if(st!=='Success')throw new Error('VOC1019 EXPORT 기대 Success, 실제 '+st+(denied?'(권한없음)':''));})()
